title: Generate typed layer-port provider queries for editor choices
body: The editor view projection had to hand-code Provide opcode 4 and the field/set port names in VIXEN/application/editor/source/EditorApplication.cpp to populate ReadPort and port-valued argument selectors. The existing model-side proposal covers type inference and flattening, but the generated consumer surface still does not expose typed provider ports, matching queries, or selector payloads. Consolidate the declarative layer-port catalogue through the view/AppFlow consumer so editor choice rows and wire actions derive from the same source.
